findings.title: SendGrid client used for cancellation is never configured with the API key
findings.body: This module configures `sgMail` with `SENDGRID_API_KEY`, but it never calls `client.setApiKey(...)` before using `client.request` to cancel scheduled sends at line 57. `@sendgrid/client` has separate configuration from `@sendgrid/mail`, so the new cancellation request can fail authentication and leave the SendGrid email scheduled. Configure the client in this module before making cancellation requests.

findings.title: Expired cancelled reminders are deleted before SendGrid cancellation can be retried
findings.body: The initial `deleteMany` removes every email reminder whose scheduled date has passed, including reminders with `cancelled: true`. If the cancellation request failed during a prior cron run (or one failed request aborted the loop at line 75), the next run deletes the only local record before attempting to cancel its SendGrid batch. The SendGrid scheduled send remains active and can still be delivered. Cancelled reminders must be excluded from this cleanup until the provider cancellation succeeds, or cancellation must be processed before cleanup with durable retry handling.

findings.title: Cancellation does not wait for workflow reminders to be marked cancelled
findings.body: `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` and `deleteScheduledSMSReminder` are asynchronous, but the calls inside these `forEach` loops are neither awaited nor collected into the later `Promise.all`. Previously the handler awaited the Prisma reminder deletions; now it can return successfully before email reminders have been marked `cancelled` for the cron job. In particular, in serverless/request teardown scenarios this work may not complete, and provider/database errors are detached from the cancellation request. Collect and await these operations before completing booking cancellation.
